name: nonagon
draw: A regular nine sided polygon outline standing on one flat edge.

name: dodecagon
draw: A regular twelve sided polygon outline, nearly round but with visible short straight edges and corners.

name: isosceles-triangle
draw: A tall narrow triangle with a single tick mark on each of its two equal slanted sides.

name: scalene-triangle
draw: A lopsided triangle with three different side lengths, marked with one, two and three tick marks.

name: obtuse-triangle
draw: A long flat triangle with one wide angle over 90 degrees at the bottom left, marked with a small arc.

name: kite-quadrilateral
draw: A geometric kite shape with a short top and long bottom, its two diagonals drawn crossing at right angles.

name: squircle
draw: A superellipse shape between a square and a circle, with straight-ish sides blending into smooth rounded corners.

name: annulus
draw: A flat ring: two concentric circles with the band between them filled.

name: quarter-circle
draw: A quarter of a circle: two straight radii at a right angle joined by a curved arc.

name: deltoid-curve
draw: A curved triangle with three sharp cusps and three inward curving sides.

name: lune-shape
draw: Two overlapping circles where only the thin crescent region of one outside the other is filled.

name: arbelos
draw: A large semicircle with two smaller semicircles inside it resting on the same base line, the curved region between them filled.

name: concave-polygon
draw: An arrowhead like polygon with one corner pushed inward, its reflex angle marked with an arc.

name: pentagram
draw: A five pointed star drawn as one continuous line of five crossing strokes, with the inner pentagon visible.

name: heptagram
draw: A seven pointed star polygon drawn with crossing straight lines that leave a small heptagon in the middle.

name: octagram
draw: Two overlapping squares, one rotated 45 degrees, forming an eight pointed star with an octagon center.

name: tetrahedron
draw: A triangular pyramid with four triangular faces, drawn in three quarter view with one hidden edge dashed.

name: cuboid
draw: A long rectangular box in three quarter view showing front, top and side faces.

name: parallelepiped
draw: A slanted box whose faces are parallelograms, leaning to one side in three quarter view.

name: rhombohedron
draw: A squashed cube whose six faces are all rhombuses, drawn like a slanted diamond solid.

name: ellipsoid
draw: A stretched egg-like solid shown with an outer ellipse outline and a curved equator line across it.

name: triangular-bipyramid
draw: Two triangular pyramids joined base to base, forming a double pointed solid with a triangular waist.

name: pentagonal-prism
draw: A prism with pentagon shaped front and back faces joined by rectangular sides, in perspective.

name: cuboctahedron
draw: A solid with square and triangular faces alternating, shown with a square face in front surrounded by triangles.

name: truncated-cube
draw: A cube with each corner sliced off, leaving small triangular faces at the corners and octagonal faces.

name: truncated-tetrahedron
draw: A tetrahedron with its corners cut off, showing hexagonal faces and small triangular corner faces.

name: truncated-octahedron
draw: A solid of square and hexagonal faces, shown with a hexagon face in front and small squares around it.

name: stellated-octahedron
draw: Two interlocking tetrahedra forming an eight pointed star solid, like a three dimensional six pointed star.

name: stellated-dodecahedron
draw: A spiky ball solid with twelve pentagonal pyramid spikes pointing outward, like a star shaped polyhedron.

name: rhombic-dodecahedron
draw: A solid of twelve rhombus faces, drawn as a hexagon outline divided into rhombus faces around a center.

name: square-antiprism
draw: Two squares, one rotated 45 degrees above the other, joined by a band of zigzag triangles.

name: bicone
draw: A double cone: two cones joined at their round bases, forming a spinning top like solid with pointed ends.

name: spherical-cap
draw: A dome shaped slice cut from a sphere, with a flat elliptical base and a curved top.

name: paraboloid
draw: A bowl shaped surface opening upward, with an elliptical rim and curved sides meeting at a rounded bottom.

name: hyperboloid
draw: An hourglass shaped tower surface made of straight crossing lines, pinched at the waist between two elliptical rims.

name: hyperbolic-paraboloid
draw: A saddle shaped surface with a grid of curved lines, rising at two opposite corners and dipping at the other two.

name: torus-knot
draw: A closed tube looping several times around a hidden ring, forming a star like knot with over and under crossings.

name: double-torus
draw: A flat pretzel like solid with two holes side by side, drawn with shading lines around each hole.

name: wireframe-cube
draw: A see-through cube with all twelve edges drawn, the three hidden back edges shown dashed.

name: impossible-cube
draw: A wireframe cube whose front and back edges cross in an impossible way, one bar passing in front of another it should be behind.

name: penrose-stairs
draw: A square loop of steps seen from above at an angle that appears to climb forever back to its start.

name: impossible-fork
draw: Three round prongs on the left that merge into two square prongs on the right, an impossible trident illusion.

name: cylinder-net
draw: The unfolded net of a cylinder: a rectangle with a circle attached above and below.

name: cone-net
draw: The unfolded net of a cone: a curved fan shaped sector with a small circle touching its arc.

name: pyramid-net
draw: The unfolded net of a square pyramid: a central square with a triangle on each of its four sides, like a star.

name: triangular-prism-net
draw: The unfolded net of a triangular prism: three rectangles in a row with a triangle on the top and bottom of the middle one.

name: solid-of-revolution
draw: A curve beside a vertical axis with a curved arrow around the axis and the vase shaped solid it sweeps out.

name: spherical-triangle
draw: A sphere outline with a curved triangle drawn on its surface, its three sides bulging arcs of great circles.

name: poincare-disk
draw: A circle filled with curved arcs meeting its edge at right angles, forming shrinking curved triangles toward the rim.

name: sphere-packing
draw: Front view of equal balls stacked in a triangular pyramid, three on the bottom row, two above and one on top.

name: cavalieri-principle
draw: Two stacks of equal coins side by side, one straight and one leaning sideways, showing equal volume.

name: right-angle
draw: Two straight rays meeting at a corner at 90 degrees with a small square mark in the corner.

name: obtuse-angle
draw: Two rays from one vertex spread wider than a right angle, with an arc marking the wide opening.

name: straight-angle
draw: A straight line with a dot at its center and a half circle arc above marking 180 degrees.

name: reflex-angle
draw: Two rays from one vertex with a long arc sweeping around the outside, marking the angle larger than 180 degrees.

name: complementary-angles
draw: A right angle corner split into two parts by a middle ray, each part marked with its own arc.

name: supplementary-angles
draw: A straight line with a ray rising from a point on it, the two angles on either side marked with arcs.

name: vertical-angles
draw: Two straight lines crossing in an X with matching arcs on the two opposite angles.

name: exterior-angle
draw: A triangle with its base extended past one corner and an arc marking the outside angle formed there.

name: dihedral-angle
draw: Two flat planes meeting along a shared edge like an open book, with an arc marking the angle between them.

name: solid-angle
draw: A cone of rays from a center dot to a patch on the surface of a surrounding sphere.

name: angle-of-elevation
draw: A horizontal ground line with an eye dot at one end and a sight line rising to a flag or tree top, the angle marked.

name: intersecting-lines
draw: Two straight lines crossing at a slant with a dot marking their single intersection point.

name: segment-midpoint
draw: A straight line segment with dots at both ends and a middle dot, each half marked with one tick.

name: collinear-points
draw: Three dots lying on one straight line with a thinner line running through them.

name: geometric-plane
draw: A flat parallelogram drawn in perspective representing an infinite plane, with a small point dot on it.

name: normal-vector
draw: A flat plane in perspective with an arrow standing straight up from it and a right angle mark at its foot.

name: skew-lines
draw: Two straight lines drawn on a box outline that never meet and are not parallel, one passing behind the other.

name: triangle-medians
draw: A triangle with three lines from each corner to the midpoint of the opposite side, meeting at a center dot.

name: triangle-altitude
draw: A triangle with a dashed vertical line dropped from the top corner to the base, with a right angle mark.

name: triangle-incircle
draw: A triangle with a circle drawn inside touching all three sides.

name: triangle-circumcircle
draw: A triangle with a circle drawn around it passing through all three corners.

name: similar-triangles
draw: A small triangle and a larger triangle of the same shape side by side, with matching angle arcs.

name: congruent-triangles
draw: Two identical triangles side by side, with matching tick marks on their corresponding sides.

name: triangle-angle-sum
draw: A triangle whose three corner angles, each marked with an arc, are shown fitted together along a straight line below.

name: thales-theorem
draw: A semicircle with a triangle whose long side is the diameter and whose top corner touches the arc, marked with a right angle.

name: circle-chord
draw: A circle with a straight line joining two points on its edge, not passing through the center.

name: circle-diameter
draw: A circle with a straight line passing through its center dot from edge to edge, with dots at both ends.

name: tangent-circles
draw: Two circles of different sizes touching at exactly one point, marked with a small dot.

name: inscribed-polygon
draw: A regular hexagon drawn inside a circle with every corner touching the circle.
